key_highlights: ASX slumps as miners and banks sell off sharply; oil near US$100 on Trump's Iran war escalation
Iron ore weakness spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
Australian business conditions weakest since pandemic, signalling broad economic stress
Gold sector surges: multiple WA/NSW juniors report high-grade hits and secure funding (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania)
AUD faces downward pressure amid oil shock and Chinese inflation spike
High-end property prices decline sharply while affordable segment remains resilient; NSW stamp duty revenue hit
Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market, raising systemic risk concerns
Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; energy transition challenged by AI data centre demand at coal sites

sectors.trend: Sharp sell-off in iron ore names (BHP, RIO, FMG) as ore prices weaken; gold juniors counter-trend with strong exploration results and funding rounds
sectors.implications: Diversify away from iron ore exposure; gold juniors (Gateway, Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania) offer relative strength but carry exploration risk

sectors.trend: Banks sharply lower on ASX slump; private credit stress from Bathla collapse raises credit-quality concerns; housing stress at top end pressures mortgage books
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from rate uncertainty and property risk; monitor NIM and credit loss provisions

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Iran war; positive for Woodside, Santos, OilSearch; gas reservation policy shift under Albo creates uncertainty
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, STO.AX, OSH.AX benefit from oil spike but face policy risk; data centre power demand at coal sites (AGL, Origin) creates new revenue streams

sectors.trend: High-end residential prices in steepest decline; NSW stamp duty revenue hit; affordable segment resilient; property chiefs call for more migrants
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, DGL.AX) face mixed signals; residential builders (WBC-linked) under pressure; monitor RBA response to housing stress

sectors.trend: Dementia prevention research highlights systemic gaps; consumer conditions weak; business sentiment at pandemic lows
sectors.implications: CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive quality; consumer discretionary (WES.AX, WOW.AX) face headwinds from weak business conditions

sectors.trend: AI data centre buildout at coal sites; Qualcomm-Amazon AI deal; Austal US$1.9b bid; private credit stress
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech exposure limited; AGL.AX, ORG.AX benefit from data centre power demand; Austal (AUS.AX) bid is positive catalyst

key_themes: Oil at US$100 driven by Trump-Iran conflict creates stagflation risk for Australia
Iron ore structural weakness pressures ASX 200 heavyweight miners
Gold exploration boom in WA/NSW attracts capital rotation from iron ore
Housing bifurcation: luxury decline vs affordable resilience
Business conditions at pandemic lows signal potential RBA easing
Private credit contagion risk from Bathla collapse
Chinese inflation spike threatens commodity demand outlook
Energy transition disrupted by AI data centre power demand

risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic energy producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX); monitor Brent crude and RBA response
Reduce BHP.AX/RIO.AX/FMG.AX weightings; rotate into gold and copper names
Avoid leveraged credit exposures; monitor bank NIM and provision trends
Hedge USD-denominated liabilities; favour export-oriented miners and energy
Avoid luxury REITs; favour affordable-segment and industrial REITs
Monitor PRC PMI and commodity import data; reduce cyclical exposure

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight domestic energy producers on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: US$100 oil from Iran war directly boosts WDS, STO, OSH earnings; gas reservation policy adds optionality

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into WA/NSW gold juniors on exploration momentum
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits and funding rounds signal sector upcycle; gold hedges oil-driven inflation

opportunities.recommendation: Add copper exposure on structural demand
opportunities.rationale: Flagship increasing Canadian copper stakes; red metal soars on energy transition and data centre buildout
CSL and SGH offer earnings visibility amid weak business conditions and rate uncertainty

defensive_moves.rationale: Spreading ore weakness and Chinese inflation risk threaten BHP/RIO/FMG margins

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD and rate risk via defensive REITs and staples
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD shocker looms; RBA likely to ease, supporting rate-sensitive defensive names

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid private credit and leveraged structures
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals contagion risk across alternative credit markets

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months as oil-driven inflation, iron ore weakness, and weak business conditions weigh on sentiment. RBA easing expectations provide partial support. Gold and energy outperform; banks and iron ore lag. Volatility elevated on Iran war headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA cuts 50–75bps and oil stabilises below US$110. Gold sector upcycle and copper demand from data centres/energy transition support structural mining gains. Housing correction at top end may moderate but affordable segment resilience limits systemic risk. Key risk: prolonged Iran conflict pushing oil above US$120.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decision and statement
Brent crude trajectory and Iran war developments
Iron ore contract pricing (62% Fe) and Chinese steel data
Australian employment and business conditions data
NSW budget stamp duty revenue impact
Gold price (XAU/USD) and junior exploration results
watch_list: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX iron ore exposure
Brent crude and iron ore futures
RBA policy rate and forward guidance
Chinese CPI, PMI, and property data
Private credit and bank NIM trends
